name: spy_bull_put_credit_spread

entry_rules.regime_filter: SPY close > SMA(80) of daily closes (completed bar)
entry_rules.signal: On any trading day whose completed close meets the regime filter and no position is open, open a bull put credit spread at next day open
contract_legs: SELL_TO_OPEN short put at strike round_to_1(spot * 0.95) with expiration ~30 calendar days out
BUY_TO_OPEN long put at strike round_to_1(spot * 0.88) with same expiration
entry_rules.expiration_selection: target_dte=30 calendar days; pick the nearest available trading day on/after target_dte using SPY trading calendar

exit_rules.take_profit: close spread when modeled mid-market cost-to-close drops to <= 50% of entry credit (capture >= 50% of max profit)
exit_rules.underlying_breach: close spread at open if prior close < short strike (intrinsic loss control)
exit_rules.expire: if held to expiration and underlying > short strike, spread expires worthless, full credit retained

SMA.definition: simple arithmetic mean of last 80 completed daily closes

fill_model.name: next_open
fill_model.description: Signal determined at bar T close; spread opened at bar T+1 open. Premiums modeled via Black-Scholes at the fill-day open underlying price with fixed calibrated IV + round-trip spread friction. Exits likewise execute at next-day open.

option_pricing_model.note: Historical per-contract option bars are not available on this paper data subscription. Premiums are modeled with Black-Scholes calibrated to the live chain (ATM SPY IV ~0.125 on 2026-08-27) with a conservative IV uplift to 0.15 and 100bp round-trip friction. Real fills during paper forward-validation will replace modeled prices.

benchmark: SPY buy-and-hold, same data window, buys as much SPY as possible with initial cash at first bar close, holds to end
